blocks.orig: Take a cruise over the Indian Ocean on a beautiful catamaran, and sail straight into the sunset! This cruise starts at 3:30 pm and takes you from Nungwi in the north of Zanzibar to the beautiful Nungwi Bay, with some great tunes on the sound system and of course an ice cold drink in hand! While sailing some delicious sea food snacks are prepared and served under a sky that turns from blue into the most wonderful shades or orange, pink and purple. A perfect setting for your most romantic moments! At 6:30 the catamaran docks again in Nungwi, leaving you with memories that might last a life-time…
blocks.html: Sail across the Indian Ocean on a lovely catamaran, heading right into the sunset! The cruise sets off at 3:30 pm from Nungwi in the north of Zanzibar to beautiful Nungwi Bay, with good music on the sound system and, naturally, an ice cold drink in your hand! On the way, tasty seafood snacks are prepared and served beneath a sky that changes from blue to wonderful shades of orange, pink and purple. An ideal backdrop for romantic moments! At 6:30 the catamaran returns to Nungwi, and you go ashore with memories that may stay with you for a lifetime…
